Name: Seikret Mount
Author: Blakllyte
Description:
[size=4][b]|| About ||
[/b][/size]
This mod reskins the horse to be a Seikret, a Bird-like mount from Monster Hunter Wilds! It comes with 2 variants at the moment which can be configured with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Config Menu[/url], the Regular Seikret and the Guardian Seikret, which is blue!

Monster Hunter is a very fun series i HIGHLY recommend checking it out (though if you do be warned that Wilds is not very well optimized, id recommend starting with an older game, MHRise is my personal favorite :3)

[size=4][b]|| Installation ||
[/b][/size]
- Make sure you have Content Patcher and Generic Config Menu (optional) installed.
- Download the file
- Unzip the file into your respective mod folder

[size=4][b]|| Upcoming Features ||[/b][/size]

- More colors
- Alternate version compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]
